instruction: Make the title text bold and change its color to blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255) on slide 1.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making slide 1 title bold and changing color to blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255). Custom getter extracts bold status and RGB color. Custom metric awards partial credit: 0.5 for bold, 0.5 for blue color (with ±10 tolerance per RGB component).
metadata.verification: Verified by reading the PowerPoint file: slide 1 has title 'Business Infographic Template '. Task asks to make it bold and blue.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for bold formatting, 0.5 for blue color (RGB: 0, 0, 255)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE for robust title shape detection - no hardcoded text matching
Getter has proper error handling for missing slides, shapes, and None values in color/bold properties
Getter extracts both bold status and RGB color correctly from first run of title text
Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S to persist changes before verification
Metric logic is correct: awards 0.5 for bold + 0.5 for color with appropriate tolerance (±10 per RGB component)
Expected values are semantically correct for the instruction (bold=true, RGB: 0,0,255 for blue)
Partial credit scoring is logical and covers both requirements completely
Data flow is correct: getter extracts title formatting state → metric compares bold and color → score reflects both requirements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter only checks first run of title text. If title has multiple runs with different formatting, only first run is verified. Consider checking all runs or majority formatting, though this is rare for titles.
